changelog: Fixes ready-made channel suggestions returning zero channels, even after a long wait: the last release's franchise-completion feature was scanning every collection in the library once per chosen film - hundreds of times over in one request - rather than once for the whole request, on any server with a real collection count. Built once now and looked up per film instead of recomputed.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
